defs.def: a period of ten years, especially a continuous period, such as 1910–1919 or 2000–2009 十年，十年期（尤指一个年代）

ex.s: The research, carried out by scientists at the Columbia Climate School and other institutions, found that if the city maintains past species patterns in new plantings, isoprene production in Manhattan in coming decades will go up by about 140%, and resulting summer ozone levels as much as 30%.
ex.t: 这项由哥伦比亚气候学院及其他机构的科学家开展的研究发现，如果该市在新种植中沿用过去的树种模式，未来几十年曼哈顿的异戊二烯产量将上升约140%，由此导致的夏季臭氧水平最多将上升30%。

ex.s: Suspending tree-planting for a few decades.
ex.t: 暂停植树几十年。

ex.s: Over the decades, Reisley has opened his doors to visitors.
ex.t: 几十年来，赖斯利一直向访客敞开大门。

ex.s: Regenerative brakes have been in trains for decades and are also used in some cars.
ex.t: 再生制动技术在列车中已应用了几十年，一些汽车也在使用。

ex.s: Similarly, the corporate world has certainly known its fair share of disruption, yet it is only in the last couple of decades that the “Disruptor” has become a recognisable figure in the way we talk about big business.
ex.t: 所有参与者都必须探讨通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活质量。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备或飞往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是科学知识的应用，用以解决问题，以无数方式触动生活。

ex.s: Life on city streets started to change decades ago.
ex.t: 几十年前，城市街道上的生活开始发生变化。

ex.s: The concept ___62___ (be) certainly not new — men have been renting good suits for decades — but for female shoppers, it is just taking off.
ex.t: 这一概念____62____（绝非）新鲜——男人租用好西装已有几十年——但对女性购物者来说才刚刚兴起。

ex.s: This is why Campbell has set out to raise awareness of AI and its future now — several decades before these developments are expected to take place.
ex.t: 这就是为什么坎贝尔现在就开始提高人们对人工智能及其未来的认识——比这些发展预计发生的时间早了几十年。

ex.s: About a decade ago, I noticed that she began to lose her hearing.
ex.t: 大约十年前，我注意到她开始丧失听力。

ex.s: Habitat loss, pesticide use, and climate change have caused dramatic declines in pollinator populations over the past couple of decades, which has damaged the US agricultural economy.
ex.t: 栖息地的丧失、杀虫剂的使用和气候变化在过去几十年中导致传粉昆虫数量急剧下降，这损害了美国农业经济。

ex.s: Human impact on the animal kingdom, such as hunting and destruction of habitats, ___________a reduction in the population of certain species in the past three decades.
ex.t: 人类对动物王国的影响，如狩猎和栖息地破坏，________导致过去三十年某些物种种群数量的减少。

ex.s: As an award-winning cookbook author, Ms Young, now 66, has spent decades shopping the same way in New York’s Chinatown.
ex.t: 作为一位获奖食谱书作者，现年66岁的杨女士几十年来一直以同样的方式在纽约唐人街购物。

ex.s: For nearly a decade now, Merebeth has been a self-employed pet transport specialist.
ex.t: 近十年来，梅雷贝斯一直是一名个体经营的宠物运输专家。

ex.s: New researchers found that middle-aged women who were physically fit could be nearly 90 percent less likely to develop dementia in later life, and as they did, it came on a decade later than less sporty women.
ex.t: 新研究发现，身体健硕的中年女性晚年患痴呆症的可能性低近90%，而且即使患病，也比不爱运动的女性晚十年发作。

ex.s: These women were then tested for dementia six times over the following four decades.
ex.t: 这些女性随后在接下来的四十年中接受了六次痴呆症检测。

ex.s: For decades, quantum computing has been little more than a laboratory curiosity.
ex.t: 几十年来，量子计算不过是一种实验室里的新奇事物。

ex.s: Unfortunately, it took the explorers and the settlers who followed only a few decades to decimate a large part of these resources.
ex.t: 不幸的是，探险者和随后的定居者只用了几十年就毁掉了这些资源的很大一部分。

ex.s: An Australian professor is developing a robot to monitor the health of grazing cattle, a development that could bring big changes to a profession that's relied largely on a low-tech approach for decades but is facing a labor shortage.
ex.t: 一位澳大利亚教授正在开发一种机器人，用于监测放牧牛群的健康，这一进展可能给一个几十年来主要依赖低技术手段、正面临劳动力短缺的行业带来巨大变化。

ex.s: With the current footprint of humanity, “it seems that global collapse is certain to happen in some form, possibly within a decade, certainly within this century,” Johnson said in an email.
ex.t: 约翰逊在电子邮件中说，以人类目前的足迹来看，“全球崩溃似乎注定会以某种形式发生，可能在本十年内，肯定在本世纪内”。

ex.s: The fur trade kept nutria check for decades，but when the market for nutria collapsed in the late 1980s，the cat-sized animals multiplied like crazy.
ex.t: 皮草贸易使海狸鼠的数量得到控制了几十年，但20世纪80年代末海狸鼠市场崩溃后，这种猫大小的动物疯狂繁殖。

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《培养快乐自信孩子A到Z指南》的作者Jenn Berman说："我们已经走到了几十年前父母往往更严厉的那个极端的对立面。"通过给孩子很多表扬，父母以为在建立孩子的自信，而实际上可能适得其反。

ex.s: Especially glbalisation and better communications in the past few decades, all have caused many Languages to disappear, and dominant languages such as English.
ex.t: 尤其是近几十年的全球化和更好的通讯方式，都导致许多语言消失，而英语等主导语言正在日益占据主导地位。

ex.s: While the decline over the past decade is steep for teen readers, some data in the report shows that reading remains a big part of many children’s lives, and indicates how parents might help encourage more reading.
ex.t: 虽然过去十年青少年读者的下降幅度很大，但报告中的一些数据显示阅读仍然是许多儿童生活中的重要部分，并表明家长可能如何帮助鼓励更多阅读。

ex.s: S. who have a driver's license, who have tried alcohol, who date, and who work for pay has plummeted since 1976, with the most precipitous ___43___ in the past decade.
ex.t: 自1976年以来，拥有驾照、尝试过酒精、约过会、有偿工作的美国青少年比例急剧下降，过去十年的降幅最为明显。

ex.s: And just like crypto currencies, there are those who think the islanders are smart to invest in this type of money, which is reported to have risen in value over the last three decades.
ex.t: 只是一张专门印刷的纸和大麻纤维，我们赋予了它价值——而且随着时间的推移可能比那些贝壳更不耐用。

ex.s: Floods have become more damaging in Bangladesh in recent decades.
ex.t: 近几十年来，孟加拉国的洪灾造成的破坏越来越严重。

ex.s: But during the past decade declining rainfall has allowed him to plant highly profitable crops.
ex.t: 但在过去十年里，降雨量的减少使他能够种植高利润的作物。

ex.s: Declining birth rate is a major problem in many developing regions too, which might cause catastrophic global shortages of work force within a few decades.
ex.t: 出生率下降在许多发展中地区也是一个重大问题，可能在几十年内导致全球劳动力的灾难性短缺。

ex.s: The resistance to vaccine has continued for decades, and it is driven by a real but very small risk.
ex.t: 对疫苗的抵制已经持续了数十年，它是由一个真实但极小的风险所驱动的。

ex.s: There are probably decades in which to plan for the arrival of super intelligent machines.
ex.t: 可能有几十年时间来为超级智能机器的到来做规划。

ex.s: It will stay for a decade.
ex.t: 75   "你会保留重要的东西，"托尼说。

ex.s: Pele played professionally in Brazil for two decades, winning three World Cups along the way, and is considered to be one of the greatest football players.
ex.t: 贝利在巴西职业足坛效力了二十年，期间赢得了三届世界杯，被认为是最伟大的足球运动员之一。

ex.s: It has allowed China to accomplish in just four decades what took Western industrialised countries more than 200 years to achieve, breaking new ground in the history of human achievement.
ex.t: 它使中国在短短40年内完成了西方工业化国家200多年来取得的成就，开创了人类成就史上的新天地。

ex.s: Although Snow was not the only international journalist to set foot in China during the early decades of the 20th century, what set him apart from the others was that he actually spent time with the Chinese Red Army.
ex.t: 虽然斯诺并不是20世纪初唯一一位踏足中国的国际记者，但他与其他人的不同之处在于，他实际上在中国红军度过了一段时间。

ex.s: For now, human settlement of Mars is still decades away.
ex.t: 目前，人类在火星定居仍是几十年后的事。

ex.s: He played a key role in China’s missile and aviation programmes, helping fast-track the development by decades.
ex.t: 他在中国的导弹和航空项目中发挥了关键作用，帮助将发展进程加快了数十年。
